# Europe Insurance

> > Travel medical insurance for Schengen visa, EU residency, and European travel, delivered by AXA Assistance

Europe Insurance, distributed by INS Global in Warsaw, Poland, provides comprehensive medical and travel insurance coverage across the Schengen Area, EU, UK, and broader Europe. The platform offers instant online quotes, certificates, and policy verification for visa applications, tourism, study, and work purposes.

- Schengen visa insurance
- Travel medical coverage
- AXA Assistance partnership

- Student insurance discounts
- Online insurance certificates
- Multi-country coverage
- Visa requirements compliance
- Embassy policy verification
- INS Global distributor
- Medical repatriation
- Short-trip insurance
- EU residency coverage
- Belarus and Poland travelers
